name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza hospital strike 11 Nov; Houthi–Saudi fire
summary: An Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital killed 6 on 11 Nov; Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition keep trading strikes
state: An Israeli airstrike hit Gaza's Nasser Hospital on 11 Nov, killing six people including a medical worker, according to WHO; the UN's acting peace process coordinator warned that the violence jeopardises the Gaza ceasefire (UN News, 12 Nov). In Yemen, the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh on 10 Nov as government forces pressed a counter-offensive, and the Houthis reported 109 coalition strikes on Sanaa and other areas (Al Jazeera, 11 Nov). Cross-border strikes on the Yemen–Saudi front set the Alert.
for_you: Travellers to Israel, the Palestinian territories, Yemen and Saudi Arabia should follow FCDO travel advice. Strikes near Saudi cities and energy sites can disrupt flights and move oil prices.
rubric_hit: Alert: major cross-border strikes — Houthi missiles at Riyadh and coalition strikes in Yemen, 8–12 Nov

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
